title: FY27 NAE - Atlantic Assessment
agency_path: City of New York > Homeless Services
description_text:
DHS/HSO intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) for on-site medical and behavioral services at Atlantic Assessment Mens Shelter with current provider Sunset Park Health Council Inc. DBA Family Health Centers at NYU Langone. Medical and Behavioral Health Services at the Atlantic Assessment Men's Shelter @ 1322 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11216.

The proposed budget for this NAE is $1,670,545.00 and the term of this extension is from October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2027. The Health Service Office is currently drafting a new RFP.
Procurement and award are in accordance with PPB Rules Section 3-04(b)(2)(iii) for the reasons set forth herein.

The proposed NAE is being pursued to clients are being assessed for medical and behavioral health needs upon entering the shelter system, while the new RFP is being processed. Procurement and award are in accordance with PPB Rules Section 3-04(b)(2)(iii) for the reasons set forth herein.
